title: Missão ao Web Summit: Ambientes de Inovação, 9 a 12 de novembro de 2026 (ApexBrasil, PDF)
what_it_says: ApexBrasil's innovation-environment call for 2026: up to 10 hubs, each nominating 5 startups (up to 50 startups); registration to 30 Aug, startups named by 2 Oct 2026. The same 2026 rules say the 2025 Brazilian delegation had almost 380 companies, 247 of them supported by ApexBrasil, Sebrae Nacional and Serpro, the rest by state Sebraes; Germany and Brazil had the two largest delegations. The 2026 rules contain a date slip: the mission bullet reads 'Data: 9 a 12 de novembro de 2025' in a document for 2026.
